definitions.gloss: menstrual leave; time off for period pain
definitions.explanation: Leave from work for a woman whose period makes working very difficult. Under Japan's Labor Standards Act an employer must grant it when she asks, though the law does not require it to be paid, and few women actually take it.

examples.english: Even where the system exists, many women find it hard to tell their boss and never apply for menstrual leave.

notes:
Japan has had menstrual leave in law since 1947, earlier than most countries. Companies sometimes give it a gentler name, such as エフ⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧ or {健康休暇|けんこうきゅうか}, so that taking it is less awkward.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生理休暇|せいりきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ / ⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to take / apply for menstrual leave
- {生理休暇|せいりきゅうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取得率|しゅとくりつ}: the rate at which menstrual leave is taken

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧: paid annual leave, taken for any reason
- ⟦{生理痛|せいりつう}→生理痛：33174_seiritsuu⟧: period pain, the usual reason for the leave
